Stats.overCap: More than {cap} points in one stat (cap is level + 3).
Stats.bonusHint: Flat bonus to this stat's modifier: racial, buffs, food, mood… (Active Effects add on top)
Stats.modBreakdown: {base} from total ÷ 4, {bonus} bonus, {effects} effects. Click to roll 3d6 + mod.
Stats.scalingUnbalanced: Boosts cost {cost} but nulls only cover {credit} (major = 2, minor = 1).
Stats.demSpcMismatch: Demeanor and Speechcraft must share scaling.
Stats.scalingEnabledHint: Off treats every stat as Gen (testing aid).
Stats.rollHint: Click a modifier to open the roll window. Shift-click rolls with advantage, Ctrl-click with disadvantage.
Stats.scalingOff: Scaling is off (all stats treated as Gen). Unlock full editing to change.
Stats.totalHint: (Level + points) × scaling. Base is always your level.

Resource.lifePointsHint: Revives left. Click a pip to set.
Resource.tempHint: Temp: overflow that is used up first.
Resource.restoreHint: Refill HP, MP and FTG to max and clear temp.
Resource.restoreConfirm: Refill {name}'s HP, MP and FTG to max and clear temp values?

Defence.title: Defence
Defence.narHint: Natural armour = Steadfast mod. Physical only.
Defence.nmarHint: Natural magic armour = Wisdom mod. Magical only.
Defence.aarHint: Armour from worn armour (Inventory tab), plus the Bonus column.

Combat.title: Combat
Combat.reactionsHint: Click: empty → pass (green) → fail (red). Right-click: empty.

Inventory.title: Carrying
Inventory.beltHint: Weapons ready to use (3 belt slots on the character sheet).
Inventory.armourHint: Worn armour. Its AAR is added to this character's AAR (and so to AR and MAR).
Inventory.trinketsHint: 5 trinkets can be worn at a time, only 1 of them a class trinket. Duplicate effects from the same evolution line don't stack.
Inventory.bagHint: Everything else. Each entry takes one bag slot; max bag slots = (equip load + bag rank) × 4.
Inventory.equipLoadHint: Gear with a higher equip load than this can't be wielded (marked Too heavy).
Inventory.bagEmpty: The bag is empty. Drag gear here from a compendium, or use Add item.

Condition.injuriesHint: −1 to attack, damage and skill-check rolls per injury.

Mastery.dropHint: Drag masteries here from a compendium, or use Add mastery.
Mastery.levelTooHigh: Requires a higher level than this character has.
Mastery.anyCategoryHint: Deity and ancestry masteries can go in any category.
Mastery.addPrompt: How do you want to add a mastery to {name}?
Mastery.addFolder: Add {n} masteries from “{folder}” to {name}? Any that {name} already knows are skipped.
Mastery.onlyMasteries: Only masteries can be added to a character.
Mastery.alreadyKnownMany: {n} masteries were already known and were skipped.
Mastery.useHint: Use: skill mod roll first (if it has one), then damage

Bio.discipline2Hint: A second discipline, or a third element, or +5 Maximum Output instead.
Bio.formHint: Damage form. Player characters are Mortal unless something says otherwise.

EditMode.unlock: Unlock full editing (scaling toggle, damage form)

Resist.title: Resistances
Resist.hint: (%, positive = take less, negative = take more)
Resist.formsHint: (first number is built in from your form)

Burst.title: Burst
Burst.maxHint: Set by mood: Encouraged 3, Normal 6, Discouraged 8, Stressed 10, Overwhelmed 15.
Burst.noAlignment: Pick an alignment in Faith & outlook to see its trigger.
Burst.rules: Full gauge: revive if at 0 HP (still costs a life point), heal half max HP, MP and FTG to full, and gain your burst effect for the next minute. Once per day; the gauge resets on a long rest.
Burst.maxFromMood: Max from mood ({mood}). Change mood on the Bio tab.

Importer.title: Import from Google Sheet
Importer.menuHint: Download the Elaria Google Sheet and create or update the mastery and gear compendiums from it.
Importer.intro: Paste the link to the Elaria Google Sheet and press Check. The sheet is downloaded as a read-only copy, every mastery tab and the Gear tab are converted, and you see what will change before anything is imported. Run it again whenever the sheet changes: changed entries are updated in place, new ones are added, and nothing is duplicated.
Importer.mergedNote: Masteries shared by several disciplines are stored once and list all their disciplines ({n} duplicate copies merged).
Importer.keptSeparate: {n} shared masteries differ between disciplines and are kept as separate entries
Importer.removeMissing: Remove imported entries that are no longer in the sheet (hand-made entries are never removed)
Importer.confirm: Add {created} new entries, update {changed}, and remove {removed}?
Importer.doneNotice: Elaria data imported: {created} added, {updated} updated, {removed} removed.
Importer.linkHint: The sheet must be shared as “Anyone with the link → Viewer”. Only a copy is downloaded; nothing is ever written to the sheet.
Importer.badLinkInline: That doesn't look like a Google Sheets link (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…).
Importer.sheetWarnings: {n} things to check in the sheet
Importer.sheetWarningsHint: Nothing here stops the import. These are cells the converter had to guess about or links it couldn't make; most are typos or renamed masteries or gear.
Importer.unknownTags: {n} tags not on the Tags tab
Importer.savedTo: The converted data was saved to {path}.

error.badLink: That doesn't look like a Google Sheets link. Copy the address from the sheet's browser tab (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/…).
error.notShared: Google wouldn't hand out a copy of the sheet ({detail}). Open the sheet → Share → General access → “Anyone with the link”, role Viewer, then press Check again.
error.network: Couldn't reach Google ({detail}). Check the internet connection of the computer running this browser.
error.http: Google answered with an error (HTTP {detail}). Try again in a minute.

Picker.title: Add masteries · {name}
Picker.countLimited: Showing {shown} of {n}. Narrow the search to see more.
Picker.dragHint: Click a name to read it. Press + to add it, or drag the row onto the character sheet.
Picker.browseHint: Click a name to read it. Drag a row onto a character sheet, a monster or the hotbar. (Select a token first to get + buttons that add to it.)

Dice.badBonus: That isn't a number or dice formula.
Dice.critFromSheet: The base comes from {name}'s sheet; add any extra crit from the mastery or situation. A d100 at or under the total crit chance crits.
Dice.critNoActor: No character chosen, so the base is 0. A d100 at or under the total crit chance crits.
Dice.skillNote: Skill mod {mod} · vs DC 10 + the reaction's skill mod
Dice.critSkill: Skill mod rolls don't use the character's crit. A d100 at or under the total crit chance crits.
Dice.aoeHint: Area attack: one damage roll for every target, but each target still gets its own crit roll.
Dice.perHitHint: Add the bonus to every hit instead of once. Stats always count per hit.
Dice.skillAoe: AoE: this one roll applies to all {n} targets
Dice.noReactionHint: The target doesn't react, so the ability just hits. Skip the skill mod roll.

Monster.gmOnly: Only the GM can create monsters. Ask your GM to make one and give you ownership.
Monster.name: Monster name
Monster.dcHint: Nature check DC (10/8/14/12/16 + Power) to learn this section. Only the GM sees this.
Monster.statsHint: Type the stat; the modifier is stat ÷ 4. Click a name or modifier to roll.
Monster.noAbilities: No abilities yet. Add one, or drag abilities or masteries here.
Monster.onlyAbilities: Only abilities and masteries can be added to a monster.
Monster.tokenIntro: How this monster's tokens look when you drag it onto a scene. Tokens already on the map keep their own settings.
Monster.actorLinkHint: Off (the default for monsters): every token is its own copy with its own HP. On: all tokens share this sheet.
Monster.dcVitalsHint: Nature check DC (8 + Power) to learn its HP, FTG and MP. Only the GM sees this.

Ability.hint: Everything is optional. With a skill mod it rolls the skill mod first; with damage it then rolls damage; otherwise it is posted to chat.

React.buttonHint: Roll a reaction for your selected token (or your character)
React.title: React
React.pickUnit: Select the token that is reacting, or pick it here.

type.towards: An action done to you (n + 10 + skill mod)
type.notTowards: An action not done to you (n + 14 + skill mod)
type.leavingMelee: An enemy leaving melee (n + 12 + skill mod)
type.own: Your own action, e.g. a trap (n + 16)

React.nHint: n starts at 0 every round and goes up by 2 for every successful reaction this round (failed ones don't count). Filled in from the reaction pips.
React.dcModHint: GM's call or circumstances, e.g. −2 for a head shot, +1 for the back
React.noCombat: Not in combat: the reaction pips won't be filled in.
React.noRapLeft: no reaction pips left to fill
React.passNote: The reaction happens first; the action's effect is the GM's call
React.failNote: The action goes through. The RAP is still spent, but no energy
React.useRxnPrompt: {name} is a reaction (rxn). Roll the reaction first, or use it normally?

Gear.tooHeavy: Needs equip load {need}; this character has {have}.
Gear.addPrompt: How do you want to add an item to {name}?
Gear.addFolder: Add all {n} items from “{folder}” to {name}'s bag?
